Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXIV OF 2001
STAMP (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
2001
ORDINANCE XXXIV OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Stamp Act, 1899
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 1st
November, 2001]
No. Legis.13-73/2001, dated
1-11-2001.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Stamp (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall be deemed to have
come into force on and from the 14th day of August, 2001.

Amendment in section 2 of Act II of 1899

ORDINANCE XXXIV OF 2001
STAMP (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
2001
ORDINANCE XXXIV OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Stamp Act, 1899
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 1st
November, 2001]
No. Legis.13-73/2001, dated
1-11-2001.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information.
2. Amendment in section 2 of Act II of 1899.--In the said Act, in
section 2 clause (9) sub-clause (b) the words "Deputy Commissioner"
shall be substituted by the words and brackets "District Officer
(Revenue)".

Amendment in section 27-A of Act II of 1899

ORDINANCE XXXIV OF 2001

3. Amendment in section 2'7-A
of Act II of 1899.--In the said Act, in section 27-A subsection (4) for the
word "Commissioner" the words and brackets "Executive District
